{{Otheruses|librarian}}
{{Quote|Sir, I am a librarian. I am here to assist you in whichever way you deem felicitous.|[[P-RC3]] upon arriving on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]|<ref name="Death Star (novel)">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>}}
A '''librarian droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that assisted [[Librarian/Legends|librarians]] in their jobs. In addition, they were used for data storage and processing. An example was the Librarian droid on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] that assisted [[Atour Riten]], the chief librarian.
